summary: Backend developer with 4 years of professional experience building order and inventory services using Python, FastAPI, and PostgreSQL.

experience.title: Backend Developer
bullets: Built Python services to validate customer orders and automate daily inventory reconciliation.
Developed FastAPI endpoints for order creation, status updates, and inventory lookups.
Designed PostgreSQL tables and queries for order history, stock levels, and customer records.
Implemented REST API request validation, pagination, and consistent error responses for order services.
Wrote pytest unit and integration tests for order validation, API responses, and database operations.
Used Git branches and pull requests to review changes and maintain the shared backend codebase.
